description: This file contains the implementation of an LRU (Least Recently Used) cache class, including methods for cache management such as set, get, delete, and iteration, along with internal data structures and utility functions.

classes.name: LRUCache
classes.description: A class implementing an LRU cache with configurable max size, max age, and disposal behavior.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the cache with optional configuration parameters.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Adds or updates an item in the cache.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves an item from the cache.

methods.name: del
methods.description: Deletes an item from the cache.
